@@ -1,2 +1,39 @@
+SEVERITY_ORDER = ["critical", "high", "medium", "low"]
+
+
+def _escape_cell(value):
+    return str(value).replace("|", "\\|")
+
+
 def render_report(findings):
-    return "# Findings\n"
+    rows = []
+    for finding in findings:
+        severity = finding.get("severity")
+        severity_key = severity.lower() if isinstance(severity, str) else severity
+        if severity_key not in SEVERITY_ORDER:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unknown severity: {severity!r}")
+
+        owner = finding.get("owner") or "Unassigned"
+        rows.append(
+            {
+                "severity": severity_key,
+                "title": finding.get("title", ""),
+                "owner": owner,
+            }
+        )
+
+    rows.sort(key=lambda row: SEVERITY_ORDER.index(row["severity"]))
+
+    lines = ["# Findings Report", "", f"Total: {len(rows)}", ""]
+    lines.append("| Severity | Title | Owner |")
+    lines.append("| --- | --- | --- |")
+    for row in rows:
+        lines.append(
+            "| {} | {} | {} |".format(
+                _escape_cell(row["severity"]),
+                _escape_cell(row["title"]),
+                _escape_cell(row["owner"]),
+            )
+        )
+
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
